Remark
[Dual frame and volume form]

Source: petersen:page-0052 ↗ def:pet-ch1-volume-form-local

1. ch1:1.6.5If $E_1,\ldots ,E_n$ is orthonormal, then its dual coframe is $\sigma ^i(X)=g(E_i,X)$ and \[ \operatorname {vol}=\pm \sigma ^1\wedge \cdots \wedge \sigma ^n, \] with sign determined by orientation.
